title: Gotthard Tunnel proof of concept scan
summary: Jeffrey tells of Gotthard Tunnel proof of concept scan, about 2024 at Gotthard Tunnel, Switzerland, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this is the final proof of concept, the Gotthard Tunnel.

plain: The Gotthard Tunnel is a very long railway tunnel through the Alps in Switzerland. On a show hosted by a podcaster named Jesse Michels, a researcher called Jeffrey says a scan of the tunnel in 2024, credited to a colleague named Filippo, was the final proof that their scanning method works, meaning it can see what is really underground. He brings it up to back their claim that the same method has found a huge hidden structure beneath the pyramids of Egypt.
